document_summary: Rashad announces that he has been commissioned as a messenger of God and says he had known since 1980. He argues that a messenger is an ordinary human, distinguishes final prophethood from later messengership, and treats acceptance of a messenger as a covenantal and ego test. He offers code-19 calculations, name patterns, and an Abraham–Muhammad–Rashad sequence as signs. He recounts repeatedly opening the Quran at random and interpreting the resulting passages as messages that he was fired and later forgiven. The sermon also presents reforms of the shahada, salat, zakat, Ramadan calculation, and Hajj, recounts the early publication history of the Quran code, and defends the meaning of the title Old Message, New Messenger.

What is more the Quran teaches that a messenger of God... if a person is picked out as a messenger of God, a commissioned messenger of God....there are kinds of messengers does not even guarantee Heaven. So, a messenger of God does not even guarantee heaven. And this is why we see in SURA 21, verse 28 that the messengers are worried about their own neck. We are all familiar with these verses. And the Quran repeats "stay with those who do not ask you for wages." The Quran says in SURA 49... Quran gives us the criteria of who is better than whom. And in says in Arabic (49:13) إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ The best among you is the most righteous. It didn't say the best among you is the messenger of God, or the richest, or the tallest, or the most knowledgeable. "The best among you is the most righteous." So, all these things will teach us that messenger of God is no big deal. It is just a vehicle that God uses to communicate with us. A center of information.
